reuse_limit: The existing automations projection has executor-bound IDs, fixed fold=0, no native create/delete/tombstone or replay ledger, and no connector-neutral role-bound receipts. Native semantics extend its storage rather than creating another executing scheduler.

time.instant: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ; UTC offsets, subseconds and naive timestamps rejected
time.civil: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS + exact IANA key + explicit fold 0/1
time.timezone_data: SHA-256 of the exact system TZif bytes used by ZoneInfo.from_file; cache not trusted
time.timezone_key: UTC or normalized Area/Location key; aliases retain their supplied identity and are not silently equated

recurrence.weekdays: WEEKLY only; sorted unique ISO weekdays 0=Monday ... 6=Sunday, nonempty
recurrence.daily_weekly: civil clock anchored by start, week begins Monday
recurrence.hourly: elapsed UTC intervals anchored by start

time.tzif_drift: FAIL_CLOSED; provide the exact reviewed original TZif data or create a separately versioned update; no silent reinterpretation

serialization.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM or terminal newline
serialization.canonical_json: Unicode keys sorted by codepoint; compact separators; non-ASCII unescaped; no floats, duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers or surrogate bytes
serialization.capacity_overflow: transaction rollback before commit; stored histories remain exportable

mutation.update: complete replacement value of a live event at exact version
mutation.delete: exact live version, value=null; durable versioned tombstone; no ID resurrection
mutation.version: each accepted new operation creates version+1
mutation.transaction: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE, CAS and append-only ledger atomically committed
mutation.idempotency: Same operation ID + identical canonical request returns history and fresh current readback. Replays always leave local_post_effect_readback_verified=false; current_readback_matches_original is a separate observation. Changed request bytes collide.
mutation.post_effect_readback: independent post-commit read must match exact successor; competing write fails closed; ambiguous committed write is retried by identical operation ID
mutation.evidence_reset: active sync receipts require current event version/hash and current subject; successor changes do not transfer old evidence

sync.target_repository_subject: independently bound; distinct from source; no inferred equality
sync.contradictions: reject mismatched versions/hashes/roles/subjects/readback, receipt ID collisions or changed bytes under an immutable target revision
sync.provided_readback: consistency of caller-provided observation and current repository event only
sync.authentication_boundary: authenticated API caller owns source/connector authenticity; imported metadata does not authenticate an external endpoint

replay.destination: empty native store; exact snapshot subject required
replay.validation: reconstruct every CAS successor, predecessor hash, sequence, stable IDs, tombstone and receipt binding before write
replay.history: older exact heads within the same repository/role remain historical; active evidence is filtered to current subject
